1. (Currently amended) A cell comprising: a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide, __wherein the cell is a eukaryotic cell__.

2. (Currently amended) The cell of claim [[1wherein]] __1, wherein__ the non-native compartment is self-assembled in vivo.

3. (Currently amended) The cell of claim [[1wherein]] __1, wherein__ the non-native compartment further comprises at least one targeted enzyme.

4. (Currently amended) The cell of claim [[3wherein]] __3, wherein__ the non-native compartment comprises a plurality of different targeted enzymes.

5. (Currently amended) The cell of [[eihe* claim3er-ctaim-4]] __either claim 3 or claim 4,__ wherein the at least one targeted enzyme comprises a compartment-specific targeting signal sequence.

6. (Previously presented) The cell of [[claim1any-preceding-claim]] __any preceding claim__ wherein the BMC polypeptide comprises a Eut polypeptide.

7. (Previously presented) The cell of [[claim6wherein]] __6, wherein__ the Eut polypeptide comprises a EutS polypeptide.

8. (Currently amended) The cell of [[claim1any pr-eceding-claim]] __any preceding claim,__ wherein the proteinaceous shell comprises a plurality of different BMC polypeptides.

9. (Currently amended) The cell of [[claim8wherein]] __8, wherein__ the plurality of different BMC polypeptides comprises BMC polypeptides from different bacterial species.

10. (Currently amended) The cell of [[claim8wherein]] __8, wherein__ the plurality of different BMC polypeptides comprises BMC polypeptides from different BMC operons __from the same bacterial species__.

11. (Previously presented) The cell of [[claim1any-preeeding-claim]] __any preceding claim__ wherein at least one BMC polypeptide comprises an affinity tag.

12. (Currently amended) A method __of producing a non-native compartment in a eukaryotic host cell,__ comprising: introducing into a host cell a polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide, thereby producing a transformed cell; and growing the transformed cell under conditions effective for the transformed cell to express the polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide and produce a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising the at least one BMC polypeptide.

13. (Currently amended) The method of [[claim12wherein]] __12, wherein__ the host cell comprises a bacterium.

14. (Currently amended) The method of [[claim13wherein]] __13, wherein__ the bacterium comprises a member of the family Enterobacteriaceae.

15. (Currently amended) The method of [[claim14wherein]] __14, wherein__ the member of the family Enterobacteriaceae comprises E. coli.

16. (Currently amended) The method of [[claim13wherein]] __13, wherein__ the bacterium comprises a member of the family Shewanellaceae.

17. (Currently amended) The method of [[claim12wherein]] __12, wherein__ the host cell comprises a yeast.

18. (Currently amended) The method of [[claim17wherein]] __17, wherein__ the yeast comprises a member of the family Saccharomycetaceae.

19. (Currently amended) The method of [[claim18wherein]] __18, wherein__ the member of the family Saccharomycetaceae comprises Saccharomyces cerevisiae.

20. (Currently amended) The method of [[claim12wherein]] __12, wherein__ the host cell comprises an alga.

21. (Currently amended) A method __of producing a product in a eukaryotic cell,__ comprising: providing a cell comprising a non-native compartment comprising: a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide, and at least one enzyme that catalyzes conversion of a substrate to a product; and growing the cell under conditions effective for the at least one enzyme to catalyze conversion of the substrate to a product.

22. (Currently amended) The method of [[claim21wherein]] __21, wherein__ the product comprises a bioactive product.

23. (Currently amended) The method of [[claim21wherein]] __21, wherein__ the product comprises a drug or a drug precursor.

24. (Currently amended) The method of [[claim21wherein]] __21, wherein__ the product comprises a biofuel or a precursor of biofuel production.

25. (Currently amended) The method of [[claim21wherein]] __21, wherein__ the at least one enzyme catalyzes a step in degrading or detoxifying a toxic substrate.

26. (Currently amended) The method of [[claim21further]] __21, further__ comprising isolating at least a portion of the non-native compartments.

27. (Currently amended) The method of [[claim26wherein]] __26, wherein__ at least a portion of the non-native compartment comprise an affinity tag and isolating at least a portion of the non-native compartments comprises contacting a sample comprising the non-native compartments with an affinity substrate having selective affinity for the affinity tag.

28. (Currently amended) The cell of [[claim1anye nee f-elaims-1-11]] __any one of claims 1-11__ comprising a plurality of compartments.
